notes.title: Unique Item in Poop + Hamster Combat Beta
notes.content:
Poop Unique Item
After Hamster Combat release anyone who add Hamster Combat in their library will be rewarded with unique item in Poop, we will provide more details on release!

Release:
Hamster combat will be released at 11 Jule 2024 8:00 PM GTM+3. On release we will be giving everyone unique item for just logging in a game, this offer will be available for only 1 day after release!

Beta Access with unique drop:
From this moment we starting to take requests for beta access to our game, with special item for our beta testers.
If you want to take a part you should join our developer group:
https://i.postimg.cc/Yq8hYprj/b25b6c2bd0578570818bb76830d701e4228ed5f6-full.jpg
And message me on steam:
https://steamcommunity.com/id/IWannaSeeYourCry/

Or in our discord channel in special text channel called "beta-requests":
https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png
If you message me on discord please include your steam profile link.

Item for beta testers:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067516/657ffc95f9f1791f9abd8dbf413e6b3b3ae981de.png

Special item drop for beta testers will be available only before release.

Contacts:
If you have any suggestions or questions feel free message me on steam discussions, discord channel, or on email: gosdevproduction@gmail.com

notes.title: Poop fixes and your art work
notes.content:
Fixes:
Today we fixed issues with item drops, including DLC chests drop, for receiving this fix you need to update the game.  We also added a time limited 1 extra DLC chest drop as compensation, which will be available only for 1 day for all DLC owners by simply starting the game. Now you can receive drops just by starting the game every 3 hours for common and dlc chest and every 18 hours for rare chest.

Your Artwork suggestions:
We also want to let you know that we are planning to replace the current free common and rare chest with new chest with new items at jule 11, so those chests will be removed from drop pool and new ones will be added instead. If you have any suggestions for new items we created a text channel called "your-art-suggestions", where you can post your poop arts for new chest, if we liked any of those and decide to add it in game we will credit your nickname and give you some rewards. You can also post any suggestions about making our game better in "your-suggestions" text channel.

Click to join discord and share your poop arts!
https://i.postimg.cc/hj7d1NC6/discord-button.png

notes.title: DLC with Rare Drop + Weekend Unique Drop + Time Limited Item Store
notes.content:
DLC
We are happy to announce that we have released our DLC with unique Rare Drop!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3087510/Poop__Epic_Poop/
By buying DLC you will instantly get:

 3 keys for locked chests, each of them cost 0.25$ if you buy them separately
 1 DLC chest
 Access to DLC chest drop for playtime, every 3 hours you will get 1 DLC chest


DLC Discount
For 2 weeks you will be able to buy DLC with 40% discount, so do not miss your chance to increase your loot, unlock new great items and increase your collection!

New 3 days only drop

We are also stop dropping our release day unique Big Green Poop item and adding new time limited unique item for first weekend! For 3 days only you will be able to get special Demon Bloody Poop just for opening game!

New shop items available only for week
In addition, we start selling time-limited unique poops in our item store, first two of them:

 Poop with sauce
 Wrinkle Poop

They will be available for buying for week only!
